caption: The drawing depicts a golden or brass-colored ornamental object featuring an eagle with outspread wings. The eagle's head is turned to its right, with detailed feather textures on its wings and body. At the center of the eagle’s chest is a large, reflective shield, also in gold or brass, with subtle shading and highlights indicating its metallic surface. The eagle is perched on a bundle of arrows, and an olive branch is positioned on the eagle’s left side (the right side of the image). The entire composition is framed by a semicircular handle or ring at the top, which attaches to the eagle’s shoulders. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the metallic colors of the object. At the bottom left, the name "WAYNE WHITE" is printed in small capital letters.
title: Door Knocker
